notes: One manuscript sheet on the printed INSTITUT / DES HAUTES ÉTUDES SCIENTIFIQUES letterhead. It contains three entries: SGA 5 with barred XIII and a bracketed paragraph on the cristallin case and congruence mod p; a cancelled inscription followed by barred IV and an instruction to consult barred VII and SGA 6 barred X for the relative case; and barred XIV with the parenthetical heading Problèmes et Commentaires and a note about mod p and crystalline variants. No date, author page number, or explicit author question mark is visible. The faint lower-left 52 is archival and is represented only in a comment. The only explicit revision is the heavily cancelled inscription before IV; there is no readable explicit author expression of mathematical doubt. The transcription's uncertainty marks are reader doubts. The first candidate in the final phrase is une note, with mes and notes retained as independently unresolved alternatives. H also marks une note uncertain, so those two rows do not count macro or scope changes as H disagreements. The c_doubt flags include questions expressly listed in C_context.md even where C.tex itself supplies an unmarked reading. The body's hand is not independently identified; the inventory therefore says unnamed hand. There is one printed ornamental rule, one drawn grouping bracket, and one deletion; no mathematical diagram, separate margin note, or insertion is visible. No proof or computation was performed.
math_reading_decisions: Both occurrences consist of the written abbreviation mod followed by a separate descending p; neither is expanded into a formula or a mathematical claim.
The upper heading has X followed by three uprights, XIII. The middle numerals read IV, VII, and X; the lower heading reads XIV. Each has visible transverse strokes above and below.
The page gives reminders and references, not a proof or a stated congruence. Reading those reminders does not verify any mathematical assertion.
